patch.value: Round-trip deepening: idempotent upsert import + beads validate
Deepen pm-beads beyond import-only: idempotent re-import (upsert keyed on bead_id provenance marker), and a 'beads validate' command. Exporter, dry-run, dependency edges already shipped in 2026.6.2.

value.author: codex
value.text: SDK/CLI finding (report only): 'pm update <id> --status closed' on an already-closed item fails with exit_code 4 ('already terminal; use --force to close again'). This breaks naive upsert of closed items; worked around by omitting --status when the mapped status equals the item's current status. Suggest pm treat a no-op terminal->same-terminal status update as idempotent (no --force) so importers/sync tools can re-assert state safely.

patch.value: Round-trip deepened: idempotent upsert + validate shipped, tested, tracked.
